run.name: 12-hand-drawn
run.finalText:
The "Crumb & Co" piece is built and the title now fits on one line. I checked it in still frames only and haven't played it back.

- **Line drawing:** the wheat stem and grains and the loaf outline and score marks draw themselves on with a stroke reveal, staggered from 0.4s to 3.6s.
- **Hand-animated wobble:** the four line layers jitter in position and rotation, stepped at 12fps. It comes from expressions on position and rotation rather than keyframes.
- **Blobs:** four irregular blobs in terracotta, mustard, sage and rust fade in and then breathe slowly, each on its own timing. I used uneven scales so they don't pulse in sync.
- **Text:** "Crumb & Co" pops in letter by letter with a slightly bouncy, tilted spring from 3.0s. The tagline "baked slowly, with love" fades up word by word from 3.9s.

I made two fixes after the first check. The title was wrapping onto two lines, so I widened its box. The tagline was overlapping the title, so I moved it down.

The tagline sits a little to the right of the title's left edge, and I haven't nudged it. Two things I can change if you want: a stronger boil (bigger jitter, or 8fps) or a loaf that fills with colour once it's drawn.

items.text: boil/wobble (wiggle expression, hold keys or path keys)
